android.desc:
Talkfi app is a free app to make new friends anywhere in the world, using TalkFi you can create a community of people sharing the same interests. Download the TalkFi app to make friends and create a community of people to have a chat about your main interests. Make penpals and friends and chat with them with your same interests and based on the search parameters YOU choose.

In the TalkFi app you can make penpals and find new people to practice languages, learn about culture and make new friends. You will find friends with your same interests, for example, hiking, entrepreneurship, or anime. You can use Talkfi as language exchange app chat and use TalkFi as a conversation exchange app

You will expand your network of penpals and friends and you will be able to share audio, photos and videos to create fun chat conversations. TalkFi is perfect for social networking, you can find foreign friends, stop looking for a friend chat app, TalkFi is your best option as a make new friends app, TalkFi is a penpal app

Where do you want to visit when you travel?

TalkFi is a friend chat app if you are a teenager. This is the best friends chat app to find foreign friends and make new friends with foreigners, stop looking for a teen app, this is the perfect place for you to start to make new friends.

TalkFi is an app to make native people to practice languages with.

You will be able to make friends and you will have friends to talk to when you are bored. Dare to make friends using this app and enjoy a pleasant chat!

Do you like social networking ? with TalkFi you can find international friends, it is the best make friends app, Talkfi is a friends chat app where you can make new friends, TalkFi is a friendship app make a new friend, also Talkfi is a safe place
It is one of the best apps to make new friends

quotes.text:
Hi all, I'm actively looking for a co-founder to join my team, my startup is a service to meet new people, the difference with others is that i created a new moderation system so the quality of the people in my app is better than the rest of apps the main problem to resolve is the 90% of users in apps to meet people are scammers, spammers, fake accounts, stalkers and rude people
so the users are happy using my app because with my new moderation sytem they can know who are good people and who are bad people and my moderation system can detect and delete and block the bad people automatically, that is my competitive advantage

traction :

50K+ sent messages by day

1.5M+ sent messages by month

150K+ downloads

50k+ monthly active users

app : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=schan.main i am looking for a cofounder with experience getting investment and experience growing the user base with marketing strategies

if you are interested or you know someone who you believe could be interested in being part of my team please send me a message here in the forum or my email schateen.inc@gmail.com thanks....
